title: Accidentally Wide
joke: Tyrol swears the spec said 'slim.' The metal disagreed.
plain: Viper is 25% chunkier: more hurtbox, more intercepted strays.

advice.baltar: I am now a larger target. I did not ask for this responsibility.
advice.roslin: More surface area catching fire than civilians. That's a fleet-first trade.

title: Anyone Could Be a Cylon
joke: Gaeta reports two transponders. One pilot. He's chosen not to ask.
plain: Once per cycle per stack, a lethal hit downloads you into a fresh Viper with 1.5 s cover.

advice.baltar: Die once, come back once. I'd call that a fair trade, wouldn't you?
advice.roslin: A lethal hit becomes a fresh start, once a cycle. Don't waste the reprieve.

title: Bootleg Hooch (Unlabeled)
joke: Tyrol's private stash. The gun found a rhythm; your legs did not.

advice.baltar: Faster trigger, slower feet. I've made worse trades for less alcohol.
advice.roslin: Firepower up, mobility down. Pick your moments, not your enemies.

title: Continuity of Government
joke: The quota survived the meeting. So does the fleet.

advice.baltar: A lower ceiling on the damage, and another copy lowers it again. I adore a ceiling.
advice.roslin: Each copy caps how much the fleet can lose in one cycle. That is the policy.

title: Flak Enthusiast
joke: Galactica opened the mail. She did not enjoy it.
plain: Galactica intercepts 40% of strays, plus 15% per extra stack. Strafes still land.

advice.baltar: Some of the little ones never arrive. The ones that dive still do. I will be indoors.
advice.roslin: The guns take a share of the strays, more with each copy. You still catch the dive.

title: Hangar Door Slam
joke: The doors are a suggestion. Your timing is the point.
plain: +30% damage to the resurrection ship while its bays are open, per stack.

advice.baltar: They only pay you while the bays are open. Another copy pays more.
advice.roslin: Hit the factory in the open half of its cycle. Each copy hits harder then.

title: Imaginary Six
joke: She flies your wing. The rest of the fleet will have questions.
plain: A wingman only you can see. She cuts down strafes and stray rounds in range. Others will ask who you are talking to.

advice.baltar: I see no one, and the strays are thinner. I have decided not to look.
advice.roslin: She takes strafes and strays near you. Let the others ask. You keep the fleet.

title: Raptor Escort
joke: They volunteered for the mail. Three holes, and they remember the hangar.
plain: A Raptor patrols the fleet line and soaks strays. After 3 hits it hangars until the next cycle.

advice.baltar: Someone else is standing in the way. After three hits they go inside.
advice.roslin: They soak strays until three hits, then the hangar until the next jump. Cover that gap.

title: Overcompensating Cannon
joke: The shot left late. It intends to be remembered.
plain: Slower, bigger shots that pierce two extra Raiders per stack.

advice.baltar: Slower, wider, and it keeps going. Each copy adds two more Raiders.
advice.roslin: Lead it. Each copy punches through two more, and it will not speed up.

title: Personal Vendetta
joke: The missile has chosen a ship and will not be reasoned with.
plain: Missiles lock the resurrection ship whenever it is on screen. -20% missile speed. Escorts still intercept.

advice.baltar: It wants the factory, and it is slower about it. Escorts can still eat it.
advice.roslin: Your missiles lock the factory while it is up. Slower, and escorts still intercept.

title: Your Call Is Important to Us
joke: Your resurrection is important to us. Please hold.

advice.baltar: Two more seconds on hold, per copy. I have never loved a queue more.
advice.roslin: Each copy delays their return by two seconds. Spend that quiet.

title: Spoilers
joke: You have already read the part where they come back.
plain: Ghost blips sit on the return column. Shooting one delays that download 3 seconds per stack.

advice.baltar: Shoot the ghost and the download waits. Three seconds a copy. I love being early.
advice.roslin: The blip sits where it will return. A hit holds it there, longer with each copy.

title: The Fleet's Water Filter
joke: Someone poured poison into the main tank. The new filter would like a word.
plain: Jump repair +10% of missing fleet health per stack after a cycle under half the damage cap, fading to nothing at the cap. Viper hull -1 per stack.

advice.baltar: The civilians drink first, and my hull gets thinner. I have filed a complaint.
advice.roslin: Keep the fleet's losses low and each copy mends it faster. A brutal cycle earns nothing.

title: Starbuck's Lucky Streak
joke: Her luck is legendary. Her flight plans are a separate conversation.
plain: Each Raider destroyed gives 0.5 s of cover per stack, banked up to 1.5 s. While covered, rounds pass through you to the fleet.

advice.baltar: Keep killing and nothing touches you. Nothing touches you, so it touches us.
advice.roslin: Covered is not shielding. What misses you lands on the fleet. Choose where you fly.

title: Gaius' Lab
joke: The Cylon detector works 100% of the time. Maybe. Depends on who's asking.
plain: The resurrection ship's shield drops one cycle early. Baltar will take the credit.

advice.baltar: My work, a full cycle ahead of schedule. Do tell the President.
advice.roslin: A cycle sooner at the factory. Let him have the credit. We'll have the time.
